title: atylosia albicans
intro: Atylosia albicans, commonly known as White Leaf or White Bush Cowpea, is a tropical plant species belonging to the legume family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases, due to its health benefits such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties. The therapeutic actions of Atylosia albicans include reducing fever, alleviating pain and inflammation, and preventing the growth of bacteria and fungi. The bioactive constituents of Atylosia albicans include flavonoids, saponins, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
